006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.MarkupLine;
009
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
012
013/**
014 * Represents an instance that references a definition.
015 * <p>
016 * This interface provides common functionality for instances that reference
017 * definitions rather than defining their own inline structure. It handles
018 * effective value resolution by delegating to the referenced definition when
019 * the instance does not override a value.
020 *
021 * @param <DEFINITION>
022 *          the Java type of the referenced definition
023 * @param <INSTANCE>
024 *          the Java type of the inline instance (when definition is inline)
025 */
026public interface IFeatureDefinitionReferenceInstance<
027    DEFINITION extends IDefinition,
028    INSTANCE extends INamedInstance>
029    extends INamedInstance {
030
031  @Override
032  DEFINITION getDefinition();
033
034  @Override
035  default boolean isInlineDefinition() {
036    return false;
037  }
038
039  /**
040   * Get the instance this definition is combined with.
041   *
042   * @return the instance or {@code null} if the definition is not inline
043   */
044  @Nullable
045  default INSTANCE getInlineInstance() {
046    return null;
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  default String getEffectiveFormalName() {
051    String result = getFormalName();
052    return result == null ? getDefinition().getEffectiveFormalName() : result;
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  default MarkupLine getEffectiveDescription() {
057    MarkupLine result = getDescription();
058    return result == null ? getDefinition().getEffectiveDescription() : result;
059  }
060
061  @Override
062  @NonNull
063  default String getEffectiveName() {
064    String result = getUseName();
065    if (result == null) {
066      // fall back to the definition
067      IDefinition def = getDefinition();
068      result = def.getEffectiveName();
069    }
070    return result;
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  @Nullable
075  default Integer getEffectiveIndex() {
076    Integer result = getUseIndex();
077    if (result == null) {
078      // fall back to the definition
079      IDefinition def = getDefinition();
080      result = def.getEffectiveIndex();
081    }
082    return result;
083  }
084
085  /**
086   * The resolved default value, which allows an instance to override a
087   * definition's default value.
088   *
089   * @return the default value or {@code null} if not defined on either the
090   *         instance or definition
091   */
092  @Override
093  @Nullable
094  default Object getEffectiveDefaultValue() {
095    Object retval = getDefaultValue();
096    if (retval == null) {
097      retval = getDefinition().getDefaultValue();
098    }
099    return retval;
100  }
101}
